description: Advisory estimates; nothing was stored and no capacity is reserved.

computedAt.description: The instant every estimate of the response was computed at.

estimates.description: One per requested item, in request order.

items.description: The advisory estimate of one requested item.

options.description: The best option per requested tier that has one, ordered by tier.

items.description: The best option of one tier, with the same fields and semantics as the quote's best offer of that tier for the same single line. capacityBand (ADR 0023) is optional and omitted when unknown.

window.description: The option's delivery window as two instants (RFC 3339 UTC) and the local calendar they belong to: start and end are what a quote's offer calls window.earliest and window.latest (ADR 0011). Convert both into timeZone before taking their date.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the delivery station serving the destination.

basis.description: Promise basis: SCHEDULED from the timetable, MEASURED when a leg's measured transit pushed the arrival later (ADR 0014), NOMINAL from lane times (STANDARD only).

confidence.description: The calibrated probability, rounded to three decimals, that a quote is kept on time (ADR 0020): the share of the judged promises of its segment (tier, basis, node grade) whose lateness was within the buffer the quote carries. It is present only when the segment has at least minCalibrationObservations judgements in the window; absent means UNKNOWN, never zero, and consumers must read absence that way.

orderByAt.description: The latest instant an order can be placed and still make this window's witness pickup cutoff, as on a quote's offer; omitted when unknown.

capacityBand.description: The capacity pressure on the PromiseBook that the offer's chosen window would charge, read when the offer was quoted (ADR 0023): utilisation u = (provisional + confirmed holds) / capacity share. AMPLE: u < 0.60. TIGHT: 0.60 <= u < 0.85. SCARCE: u >= 0.85. The thresholds are constants of the service, not policy fields. A signal only: the network never computes a fee, and it reserves nothing (only POST /promises holds capacity).

constraints.description: The item-wide constraints first (no tier), then one per blocked tier, ordered by tier.

items.description: Why a tier has no option, in the quote's OfferConstraint vocabulary. tier is omitted when the constraint holds for the item on every tier alike (DESTINATION_NOT_SERVED, ITEM_QUANTITY_NOT_AVAILABLE, the two a quote reports without a groupNo); every other constraint names its tier.

code.description: Why a tier has no offer. PAST_ORDER_DEADLINE: the tier's order deadline in the destination region has passed (G19).
